integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled numerical script only corroborates the crossing identities, the published \(d=2\) quartic, and representative asymptotics; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result characterizes exactly the sufficient contraction region \(G_d\) used in the cited work; it does not assert necessity for a physical phase transition or an exact critical temperature of a particular interaction.
title: Exact all-degree boundary of a regular-tree localization criterion
